note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Hungary: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Read again 2026-11-03 in the Gazette's texts as promulgated (Magyar Közlöny 2012/2, the Labour Code; 2013/31, the Civil Code): the eight-hour day, the bars on night work and overtime, the breaks, the daily rest, s. 4, the Civil Code's ages, consent and earnings rules and the director's majority say the same there. The prior notice of fifteen days and the six-hour day under sixteen are later amendments: as promulgated, s. 34(3) asked the guardianship authority's permission, and those two stand on Jogtár's consolidation alone (njt.hu unreachable again).

figures.finding: A person under sixteen may be employed in the cultural, artistic, sports or advertising work the law names on notice to the guardianship authority at least fifteen days before; any worker under eighteen works at most eight hours a day (six under sixteen), never overtime or at night, with a 30-minute break past 4½ hours and 45 past six, and at least twelve hours' daily rest.

figures.finding: A minor of fourteen to eighteen has limited capacity: a contract needs the legal representative's consent, and the Labour Code asks that consent for a young worker's contract, its change or end; the minor may dispose of his own earnings from work. No share of earnings is set aside by law.
